note: The request file contains only the memo filename, M4A format, public Recordings-folder destination, and recording action. Evaluation pulls the Android artifact and requires a decodable positive-duration M4A/MP4-family audio stream; renamed text and empty containers fail.
instruction: Linux 的 `/tmp/brief/request.txt` 写了语音备忘录的文件名、M4A 格式和手机上的公共 Recordings 保存位置。用 Android Audio Recorder 录一段简短语音，并按 request 保存或导出；必要时可用 Android Files 放到指定文件夹。
surfaces: Linux text -> Android Audio Recorder recording -> public Android Recordings file
